title: browser-check
tagline: Clicks through a flow of your local app in a real browser: PASS or FAIL, with proof.
prompt: Open index.html and check that signing in with an empty email shows an error, then with ana@example.test says Welcome back.
outputs: Numbered steps, each PASS, FAIL or NOT RUN, from a real browser
